<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.13 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><I>Form of SpinCo PSU &#8211; In Respect of Existing MSGS PSUs</I> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>FORM OF PERFORMANCE RESTRICTED STOCK UNITS AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Dear [Participant Name]: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Pursuant to MSG
Knickerbockers Corp.&#8217;s 2015 Employee Stock Plan, as amended, on [Date] (the &#8220;<U>Grant Date</U>&#8221;), you were granted performance restricted stock units, each of which represents an unfunded, unsecured promise by MSG Knickerbockers
Corp. (formerly known as Madison Square Garden Sports Corp.) (&#8220;<U>MSG Knickerbockers</U>&#8221;) to deliver to you one share of MSG Knickerbockers Class&nbsp;A Common Stock. In conjunction with the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly known as MSGS Spinco, Inc.) (the &#8220;<U>Company</U>&#8221;) from MSG Knickerbockers on [Date] (the &#8220;<U>Distribution Date</U>&#8221;), and pursuant to the
Company&#8217;s 2026 Employee Stock Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;), you are receiving the award described in this Performance Restricted Stock Units Agreement (the &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;) of performance restricted stock units (the
&#8220;<U>Units</U>&#8221;), each of which represents an unfunded, unsecured promise by the Company to deliver to you one share of the Company&#8217;s Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, par value $.01 per share (&#8220;<U>Share</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Agreement have the meanings given to them in the Plan. The Units are subject to the terms and
conditions set forth below and in the Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.&#8195;<B><I>Awards</I></B>. In accordance with the terms of this Agreement, the target
amount of your contingent Units is [#RSUs] restricted stock units (the &#8220;<U>Target Award</U>&#8221;), which number of Units may be increased or decreased to the extent the performance criteria (the &#8220;<U>Objectives</U>&#8221;) set forth in
<U>Appendix 2</U> attached hereto have been attained in respect of the performance period set forth in Appendix 2 (the &#8220;<U>Performance Period</U>&#8221;). Each Unit shall represent an unfunded, unsecured promise by the Company to deliver to
you one Share on the Delivery Date. The Units, calculated in accordance with <U>Appendix 2</U> attached hereto, will vest upon the later of (i)&nbsp;September&nbsp;15, [year] (or the immediately preceding business day, if such date is not a business
day) and (ii)&nbsp;the date on which the Committee (as defined in Section&nbsp;12 below) determines the Company&#8217;s performance against the Objectives (the &#8220;<U>Vesting Date</U>&#8221;); <U>provided</U> that you have remained in the
continuous employ of the MSG Entertainment Group, the Sphere Entertainment Group, the MSG Knickerbockers Group or the MSG Rangers Group (each as defined below) from the Grant Date through the Vesting Date. In accordance with Section&nbsp;10(b) of
the Plan, in the discretion of the Committee, in lieu of all or any portion of the Shares otherwise deliverable in respect of your Units, the Company may deliver a cash amount equal to the number of such Shares multiplied by the Fair Market Value of
a Share on the date when Shares would otherwise have been issued, as determined by the Committee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.&#8195;<B><I>Vesting</I></B><I>.
</I>Subject to Sections&nbsp;3 and 4, you will<I> </I>automatically forfeit all of your rights and interest in any unvested Units if you do not remain continuously employed with the MSG Entertainment Group, the Sphere Entertainment Group, the MSG
Knickerbockers Group or the MSG Rangers Group from the Grant Date through the Vesting Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For purposes of this Agreement, the
&#8220;<U>MSG Rangers Group</U>&#8221; means the Company and any of its Subsidiaries. The &#8220;<U>Sphere Entertainment Group</U>&#8221; means Sphere Entertainment Co. (&#8220;<U>Sphere Entertainment</U>&#8221;) and any of its Subsidiaries, so long
as Sphere Entertainment remains </P>

an Affiliate. The &#8220;<U>MSG Entertainment Group</U>&#8221; means Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (&#8220;<U>MSG Entertainment</U>&#8221;) and any of its Subsidiaries, so long as MSG
Entertainment remains an Affiliate. The &#8220;<U>MSG Knickerbockers Group</U>&#8221; means MSG Knickerbockers and any of its Subsidiaries, so long as MSG Knickerbockers remains an Affiliate. For purposes of this Agreement, the &#8220;<U>Affiliated
Group</U>&#8221; means the MSG Rangers Group and, for so long as they remain Affiliates, the Sphere Entertainment Group, the MSG Entertainment Group and the MSG Knickerbockers Group. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For purposes of this Agreement, if you are employed by the MSG Rangers Group, your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means the Company; if you are
employed by the MSG Knickerbockers Group, your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means MSG Knickerbockers; if you are employed by the Sphere Entertainment Group, your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means Sphere Entertainment; and if you are employed by
the MSG Entertainment Group, your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means MSG Entertainment. If you are employed by both the MSG Entertainment Group and any of the Sphere Entertainment Group, the MSG Knickerbockers Group and/or the MSG Rangers Group,
your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means MSG Entertainment. If you are employed by both the Sphere Entertainment Group and any of the MSG Knickerbockers Group and/or the MSG Rangers Group, your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means Sphere
Entertainment. If you are employed by both the MSG Knickerbockers Group and the MSG Rangers Group, your &#8220;<U>Employer</U>&#8221; means MSG Knickerbockers. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.&#8195;<B><I>Vesting in the Event of Death [or][,] Disability[, or
Retirement]</I></B>.<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1</SUP> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(A)&#8195;If you cease to be employed by the
Affiliated Group as a result of your death on or prior to the Vesting Date, and Cause does not then exist, the Target Award will vest as of the cessation date. If, after June&nbsp;30, [year] <I>but </I>prior to the Vesting Date, you cease to be
employed by the Affiliated Group as a result of your death, and Cause does not then exist, your estate will receive the Units, if any, to which you would have been entitled on the Vesting Date had your employment not been so terminated. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&#8195;If you cease to be employed by the Affiliated Group while you are Disabled, and Cause does not then exist, the Units
will remain subject to vesting on the Vesting Date in accordance with Section&nbsp;1. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(C)&#8195;[If you cease to be

Transaction</I></B><I>. </I>As set forth in <U>Appendix</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1</U> attached hereto, your entitlement to the Units may be affected in the event of a MSG Entertainment Change of Control, a Sphere Entertainment Change of Control, a MSG
Knickerbockers Change of Control, a MSG Rangers Change of Control or a going-private transaction with respect to the Company, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Entertainment or MSG Knickerbockers (each as defined in <U>Appendix 1</U> attached hereto). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.&#8195;<B><I>Transfer Restrictions</I></B><I>. </I>You may not transfer, assign, pledge or otherwise encumber the Units, other than to the
extent provided in the Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.&#8195;<B><I>Unfunded Obligation</I></B>. The Plan will at all times be unfunded and, except as set forth
in <U>Appendix 1</U> attached hereto, no provision will at any time be required to be made with respect to segregating any assets of the Company or any of its Subsidiaries for payment of any benefits under the Plan, including, without limitation,
those covered by this Agreement. Your right or that of your estate to receive delivery or payment under this Agreement shall be an unsecured claim against the general assets of the Company, including any rabbi trust established pursuant to
<U>Appendix 1</U>. Neither you nor your estate shall have any rights in or against any specific assets of the Company other than the assets held by the rabbi trust established pursuant to <U>Appendix</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1</U>.

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7.&#8195;<B><I>Right to Vote and Receive Dividends</I></B><I>. </I>You shall not be deemed
to be the holder of, or have any of the rights of a stockholder with respect to, any Units unless and until the Company shall have issued and delivered Shares to you and your name shall have been entered as a stockholder of record on the books of
the Company. Pursuant to Section&nbsp;10(c) of the Plan, all ordinary (as determined by the Committee in its sole discretion) cash dividends that would have been paid upon any Shares underlying your Units had such Shares been issued will be retained
by the Company for your account until your Units vest and such dividends will be paid to you (without interest) on the Delivery Date to the extent that your Units vest. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.&#8195;<B><I>Tax Representations and Tax Withholding</I></B>. You hereby acknowledge that you have reviewed with your own tax advisors the
federal, state and local tax consequences of receiving the Units. You hereby represent to MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers, the Company and each of their respective Subsidiaries that you are relying solely on such advisors
and not on any statements or representations of MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers, the Company, any of their respective Subsidiaries or affiliates or any of their respective agents. If, in connection with the Units, your
Employer is required to withhold any amounts by reason of any federal, state or local tax, such withholding shall be effected in accordance with Section&nbsp;16 of the Plan. If your Units vest prior to payment in accordance with Section&nbsp;3(B)[
or (C)]<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">4</SUP>, then you agree to cooperate with your Employer to satisfy any tax withholding obligations, in such manner as determined by the Committee in its sole discretion. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.&#8195;<B><I>Section 409A</I></B><I>. </I>It is the intent that payments under this Agreement shall comply with Section&nbsp;409A of the
Internal Revenue Code (&#8220;<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;409A</U>&#8221;) to the extent applicable, and that the Agreement be administered accordingly. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement or any employment
agreement you have entered into with your Employer, to the extent that any payment or benefit under this Agreement is determined by your Employer to constitute <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;non-qualified</FONT> deferred compensation&#8221;
subject to Section&nbsp;409A and is payable to you by reason of termination of your employment, then (a)&nbsp;such payment or benefit shall be made or provided to you only upon a &#8220;separation from service&#8221; as defined for purposes of
Section&nbsp;409A under applicable regulations and (b)&nbsp;if you are a &#8220;specified employee&#8221; (within the meaning of Section&nbsp;409A and as determined by your Employer), such payment or benefit shall not be made or provided before the
date that is six (6)&nbsp;months after the date of your separation from service (or your earlier death). Each payment under this Agreement shall be treated as a separate payment under Section&nbsp;409A. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">10.&#8195;<B><I>Delivery</I></B><I>. </I>Subject to Sections 8, 11 and 14 and <U>Appendix 1</U> and except as otherwise provided in this
Agreement, the Shares will be delivered in respect of vested Units (if any) on the first to occur of the following events: (i)&nbsp;to you on or promptly after the Vesting Date (but in no case more than fifteen (15)&nbsp;days after such date) and
(ii)&nbsp;in the event of your death to your estate after your death and during the calendar year in which your death occurs (or such </P>

later date as may be permitted under Section&nbsp;409A) (the &#8220;<U>Delivery Date</U>&#8221;). Unless otherwise determined by the Committee, delivery of the Shares at the Delivery Date will be
by book-entry credit to an account in your name that the Company has established at a custody agent (the &#8220;<U>custodian</U>&#8221;). The Company&#8217;s transfer agent, EQ Shareowner Services, shall act as the custodian of the Shares;
<U>however</U>, the Company may in its sole discretion appoint another custodian to replace EQ Shareowner Services. On the Delivery Date, if you have complied with your obligations under this Agreement and <U>provided</U> that your tax obligations
with respect to the vested Units are appropriately satisfied, we will instruct the custodian to electronically transfer your Shares to a brokerage or other account on your behalf (or make such other arrangements for the delivery of the Shares to you
as we reasonably determine). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">11.&#8195;<B><I>Right of Offset</I></B>. You hereby agree that the Company shall have the right to offset
against its obligation to deliver shares of Class&nbsp;A Common Stock, cash or other property under this Agreement to the extent that it does not constitute <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;non-qualified</FONT> deferred compensation&#8221;
pursuant to Section&nbsp;409A, any outstanding amounts of whatever nature that you then owe to the Company or any of its Subsidiaries. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">12.&#8195;<B><I>The Committee</I></B>. For purposes of this Agreement, the term &#8220;<U>Committee</U>&#8221; means the Compensation
Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company or any replacement committee established under, and as more fully defined in, the Plan. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">13.&#8195;<B><I>Committee Discretion</I></B>. The Committee has full discretion with respect to any actions to be taken or determinations to
be made in connection with this Agreement, and its determinations shall be final, binding and conclusive. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">14.&#8195;<B><I>Amendment</I></B><I>. </I>The Committee reserves the right at any time to amend the terms and conditions set forth in this
Agreement, except that the Committee shall not make any amendment or revision in a manner unfavorable to you (other than if immaterial), without your consent. No consent shall be required for amendments made pursuant to Section&nbsp;12 of the Plan,
except that, for purposes of Section&nbsp;19 of the Plan, Section&nbsp;4 and <U>Appendix 1</U> of this Agreement are deemed to be &#8220;terms of an Award Agreement expressly refer[ring] to an Adjustment Event.&#8221; Any amendment of this Agreement
shall be in writing and signed by an authorized member of the Committee or a person or persons designated by the Committee. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">15.&#8195;<B><I>Units Subject to the Plan</I></B><I>. </I>The Units covered by this Agreement are subject to the Plan. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">16.&#8195;<B><I>Subsidiaries</I></B><I>. </I>For purposes of this Agreement, <I>&#8220;</I><U>Subsidiaries</U><I>&#8221; </I>means any
entities that are controlled, directly or indirectly, by the Company, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Entertainment or MSG Knickerbockers, as applicable, or in which the Company, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Entertainment or MSG Knickerbockers, as
applicable, owns, directly or indirectly, more than 50% of the equity interests. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">17.&#8195;<B><I>Entire Agreement</I></B><I>. </I>Except
for any employment agreement between you and the MSG Entertainment Group, the Sphere Entertainment Group, the MSG Knickerbockers Group or the MSG Rangers Group in effect as of the date of the grant hereof (as such employment agreement may be
modified, renewed or replaced), this Agreement and the Plan </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

constitute the entire understanding and agreement of you and the Company with respect to the Units covered hereby and supersede all prior understandings and agreements. Except as provided in

highest authority followed by the terms and conditions of your employment agreement, if any, followed by the terms and conditions of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">18.&#8195;<B><I>Successors and Assigns</I></B><I>. </I>The terms and conditions of this Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to

this Agreement or the Plan to be performed by you shall be deemed a waiver of the same term or condition, or of any similar or any dissimilar term or condition, whether at the same time or at any prior or subsequent time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">22.&#8195;<B><I>Severability</I></B>. The provisions of this Agreement shall be deemed severable and the invalidity or unenforceability of any
term or condition hereof shall not affect the validity or enforceability of the other terms and conditions set forth herein. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">23.&#8195;<B><I>Exclusion from Compensation Calculation</I></B>. By acceptance of this Agreement, you shall be deemed to be in agreement that
the Units covered hereby shall be considered special incentive compensation and will be exempt from inclusion as &#8220;wages&#8221; or &#8220;salary&#8221; in pension, retirement, life insurance and other employee benefits arrangements of MSG
Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers, the Company or any of their respective Subsidiaries, except as determined otherwise by MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers, the Company or any of their respective
Subsidiaries. In addition, each of your beneficiaries shall be deemed to be in agreement that all such shares be exempt from inclusion in &#8220;wages&#8221; or &#8220;salary&#8221; for purposes of calculating benefits of any life insurance coverage
sponsored by MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers, the Company or any of their respective Subsidiaries. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">24.&#8195;<B><I>No Right to Continued Employment</I></B>. Nothing contained in this Agreement or the Plan shall be construed to confer on you
any right to continue in the employ of </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PERFORMANCE RESTRICTED STOCK UNITS AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.&#8195;In the event of a &#8220;going-private transaction&#8221; with respect to the Company, as defined below, your entitlement to Units

going-private transaction with respect to the Company, deem the Objectives to be satisfied at the target level and convert your Target Award into an amount of cash equal to (i)&nbsp;the number of your unvested Units multiplied by (ii)&nbsp;the
&#8220;offer price per share,&#8221; the &#8220;acquisition price per share&#8221; or the &#8220;merger price per share,&#8221; each as defined below, whichever of such amounts is applicable. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(B)&#8195;<U>Provided</U> that you remain continuously employed with the MSG Entertainment Group, the Sphere Entertainment
Group, the MSG Knickerbockers Group, the MSG Rangers Group or the &#8220;MSG Rangers Surviving Entity,&#8221; as defined below, through the date of the earliest event described in any of (i), (ii) or (iii)&nbsp;below, any award provided for in
Paragraph 1(A) shall become payable to you (or your estate) at or promptly after (but in no event more than fifteen (15)&nbsp;days after) the earlier of (i)&nbsp;the date on which your Units would otherwise have vested had it continued in effect,
(ii)&nbsp;the date of your death or (iii)&nbsp;if, immediately prior to termination you were an employee of the MSG Rangers Group, the date on which your employment with the MSG Rangers Group or the MSG Rangers Surviving Entity is terminated
(a)&nbsp;by the Company, one of its Subsidiaries or the MSG Rangers Surviving Entity other than for Cause (as defined below) or (b)&nbsp;by you for &#8220;good reason&#8221; (as defined below), in each case so long as Cause does not then exist.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, if you become entitled to payment of an award by virtue of a termination in accordance with (iii)(a) or (iii)(b) of this Paragraph 1(B) and are determined by the Company to be a &#8220;specified employee&#8221; within
the meaning of Section&nbsp;409A, the award shall be paid to you on the earlier of: (i)&nbsp;July&nbsp;1, [year], (ii) the date that is six (6)&nbsp;months from your date of employment termination and (iii)&nbsp;any other date on which such payment
or any portion thereof would be a permissible distribution under Section&nbsp;409A. In the event of such a determination, the Company shall promptly following the date of your employment termination set aside such amount for your benefit in a
&#8220;rabbi trust&#8221; that satisfies the requirements of Revenue Procedure <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">92-64,</FONT> and on a monthly basis shall deposit into such trust interest in arrears (compounded quarterly at the rate provided below)
until such time as such amount, together with all accrued interest thereon, is paid to you in full pursuant to the previous sentence; <U>provided</U>, that no payment will be made to such rabbi trust if it would be contrary to law or cause you to
incur additional tax under Section&nbsp;409A. The initial interest rate shall be the average of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-year</FONT> SOFR fixed rate equivalent for the ten (10)&nbsp;business days prior to the date of your employment
termination. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.&#8195;In the event of a &#8220;MSG Rangers Change of Control,&#8221; as defined below, <U>provided</U> that you have
remained continuously employed with the MSG Entertainment Group, the Sphere Entertainment Group, the MSG Knickerbockers Group or the MSG Rangers Group through the effective date of the transaction that results in the MSG Rangers Change of Control,
you will be entitled to the payment of the Target Award whether or not the Objectives have been attained. </P>

(B)&nbsp;the date of your death (in which case the Target Award shall vest) or (C)&nbsp;the date on which your employment with the MSG Entertainment Group or the &#8220;MSG Entertainment Surviving Entity,&#8221; as defined below, is terminated
(i)&nbsp;by MSG Entertainment, one of its Subsidiaries or the MSG Entertainment Surviving Entity other than for Cause, (ii)&nbsp;by you for &#8220;good reason&#8221; or (iii)&nbsp;by you for any reason at least six (6)&nbsp;months, but not more than
nine (9)&nbsp;months after the effective date of the MSG Entertainment Change of Control or the going-private transaction with respect to MSG Entertainment (in which case the Target Award shall vest), in each case so long as Cause does not then
exist. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.&#8195;In the event of a &#8220;MSG Knickerbockers Change of Control&#8221; or a &#8220;going-private transaction&#8221; with
respect to MSG Knickerbockers, each as defined below, and if (1)&nbsp;immediately prior to such MSG Knickerbockers Change of Control or going-private transaction with respect to MSG Knickerbockers you were an employee of the MSG Knickerbockers Group
and (2)&nbsp;at the time of such MSG Knickerbockers Change of Control or going-private transaction with respect to MSG Knickerbockers you are not an employee of the MSG Entertainment Group, the Sphere Entertainment Group or the MSG Rangers Group,
your entitlement to the Units shall be as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Your Units shall vest at the earlier of (A)&nbsp;the date on which your Units would
otherwise have vested had they continued in effect, (B)&nbsp;the date of your death (in which case the Target Award shall vest) or (C)&nbsp;the date on which your employment with the MSG Knickerbockers Group or the &#8220;MSG Knickerbockers
Surviving Entity,&#8221; as defined below, is terminated (i)&nbsp;by MSG Knickerbockers, one of its Subsidiaries or the MSG Knickerbockers Surviving Entity other than for Cause, (ii)&nbsp;by you for &#8220;good reason&#8221; or (iii)&nbsp;by you for
any reason at least six (6)&nbsp;months, but not more than nine (9)&nbsp;months after the effective date of the MSG Knickerbockers Change of Control or the going-private transaction with respect to MSG Knickerbockers (in which case the Target Award
shall vest), in each case so long as Cause does not then exist. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.&#8195;As used herein, </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Acquisition price per share</I>&#8221; means the greater of (i)&nbsp;the highest price per share stated on the
Schedule 13D or any amendment thereto filed by the holder of twenty percent (20%) or more of the Company&#8217;s voting power which gives rise to the MSG Rangers Change of Control or the going-private transaction with respect to the Company and
(ii)&nbsp;the highest fair market value per share of common stock during the ninety <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(90)-day</FONT> period ending on the date of such MSG Rangers Change of Control or going-private transaction with respect to the
Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Cause</I>&#8221; means your (i)&nbsp;commission of an act of fraud, embezzlement, misappropriation,
willful misconduct, gross negligence or breach of fiduciary duty </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">A1-4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
against your Employer or an Affiliate thereof or (ii)&nbsp;commission of any act or omission that results in a conviction, plea of no contest, plea of <I>nolo contendere</I> or imposition of
unadjudicated probation for any crime involving moral turpitude or any felony. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Going-private
transaction</I>&#8221; means a transaction involving the purchase of Company, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Entertainment or MSG Knickerbockers, as applicable, securities described in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">13e-3</FONT> to the Exchange
Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Good reason</I>&#8221; means </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">a.&#8195;without your express written consent any reduction in your base salary or target bonus opportunity, or any material
impairment or material adverse change in your working conditions (as the same may from time to time have been improved or, with your written consent, otherwise altered, in each case, after the Distribution Date) at any time after or within ninety
(90)&nbsp;days prior to the MSG Entertainment Change of Control, the Sphere Entertainment Change of Control, the MSG Knickerbockers Change of Control or the MSG Rangers Change of Control, as applicable, including, without limitation, any material
reduction of your other compensation, executive perquisites or other employee benefits (measured, where applicable, by level or participation or percentage of award under any plans of the Company, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Entertainment or MSG
Knickerbockers, as applicable), or material impairment or material adverse change of your level of responsibility, authority, autonomy or title, or to your scope of duties; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">b.&#8195;any failure by your Employer to comply with any of the provisions of this Agreement, other than an insubstantial or
inadvertent failure remedied by your Employer promptly after receipt of notice thereof given by you; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">c.&#8195;your
Employer&#8217;s requiring you to be based at any office or location more than thirty-five (35)&nbsp;miles from your location immediately prior to such event except for travel reasonably required in the performance of your responsibilities; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">d.&#8195;with respect to the Company only, any failure by the Company to obtain the assumption and agreement to perform this
Agreement by a successor as contemplated by Paragraph 1 or Paragraph 2(A)(ii)(a). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Merger price per
share</I>&#8221; means, in the case of a merger, consolidation, sale, exchange or other disposition of assets that results in a MSG Rangers Change of Control or a going-private transaction with respect to the Company (a &#8220;<I>Merger</I>&#8221;),
the greater of (i)&nbsp;the fixed or formula price for the acquisition of shares of common stock occurring pursuant to the Merger and (ii)&nbsp;the highest fair market value per share of common stock during the ninety
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(90)-day</FONT> period ending on the date of such MSG Rangers Change of Control or going-private transaction with respect to the Company. Any securities or property which are part or all of the consideration paid for
shares of common stock pursuant to the Merger shall be valued in determining the merger price per share at the </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">A1-5 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
higher of (A)&nbsp;the valuation placed on such securities or property by the Company, person or other entity which is a party with the Company to the Merger or (B)&nbsp;the valuation placed on
such securities or property by the Committee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>MSG Entertainment Change of Control</I>&#8221; means the
acquisition, in a transaction or a series of related transactions, by any person or group, other than members of the immediate family, including descendants, of Charles F. Dolan or trusts for the benefit of Charles F. Dolan&#8217;s immediate family
(or an entity or entities controlled by any of them) or any employee benefit plan sponsored or maintained by MSG Entertainment, of the power to direct the management of MSG Entertainment or substantially all its assets (as constituted immediately
prior to such transaction or transactions). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Sphere Entertainment Change of Control</I>&#8221; means the
acquisition, in a transaction or a series of related transactions, by any person or group, other than members of the immediate family, including descendants, of Charles F. Dolan or trusts for the benefit of Charles F. Dolan&#8217;s immediate family
(or an entity or entities controlled by any of them) or any employee benefit plan sponsored or maintained by Sphere Entertainment, of the power to direct the management of Sphere Entertainment or substantially all its assets (as constituted
immediately prior to such transaction or transactions). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>MSG Knickerbockers Change of Control</I>&#8221; means
the acquisition, in a transaction or a series of related transactions, by any person or group, other than members of the immediate family, including descendants, of Charles F. Dolan or trusts for the benefit of Charles F. Dolan&#8217;s immediate
family (or an entity or entities controlled by any of them) or any employee benefit plan sponsored or maintained by MSG Knickerbockers, of the power to direct the management of MSG Knickerbockers or substantially all its assets (as constituted
immediately prior to such transaction or transactions). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>MSG Rangers Change of Control</I>&#8221; means the
acquisition, in a transaction or a series of related transactions, by any person or group, other than members of the immediate family, including descendants, of Charles F. Dolan or trusts for the benefit of Charles F. Dolan&#8217;s immediate family
(or an entity or entities controlled by any of them) or any employee benefit plan sponsored or maintained by the Company, of the power to direct the management of the Company or substantially all its assets (as constituted immediately prior to such
transaction or transactions). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>MSG Entertainment Surviving Entity</I>&#8221; means the entity that owns, directly
or indirectly, after consummation of any transaction, substantially all of MSG Entertainment&#8217;s assets (as constituted immediately prior to such transaction). If any such entity is at least majority-owned, directly or indirectly, by any entity
(a &#8220;parent entity&#8221;) which has shares of common stock (or partnership units) traded on a national stock exchange or the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">over-the-counter</FONT></FONT> market, as reported
on the New York Stock Exchange or any other stock exchange, then such parent entity shall be deemed to be the MSG Entertainment Surviving Entity; <U>provided</U> that if there shall be more than one such parent entity, the parent entity closest to
ownership of MSG Entertainment&#8217;s assets shall be deemed to be the MSG Entertainment Surviving Entity. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">A1-6 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Sphere Entertainment Surviving Entity</I>&#8221; means the entity
that owns, directly or indirectly, after consummation of any transaction, substantially all of Sphere Entertainment&#8217;s assets (as constituted immediately prior to such transaction). If any such entity is at least majority-owned, directly or
indirectly, by any entity (a &#8220;parent entity&#8221;) which has shares of common stock (or partnership units) traded on a national stock exchange or the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">over-the-counter</FONT></FONT> market, as reported on the New York Stock Exchange or any other stock exchange, then such parent entity shall be deemed to be the Sphere Entertainment
Surviving Entity; <U>provided</U> that if there shall be more than one such parent entity, the parent entity closest to ownership of Sphere Entertainment&#8217;s assets shall be deemed to be the Sphere Entertainment Surviving Entity. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>MSG Knickerbockers Surviving Entity</I>&#8221; means the entity that owns, directly or indirectly, after consummation
of any transaction, substantially all of MSG Knickerbockers&#8217; assets (as constituted immediately prior to such transaction). If any such entity is at least majority-owned, directly or indirectly, by any entity (a &#8220;parent entity&#8221;)
which has shares of common stock (or partnership units) traded on a national stock exchange or the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">over-the-counter</FONT></FONT> market, as reported on the New York Stock Exchange or
any other stock exchange, then such parent entity shall be deemed to be the MSG Knickerbockers Surviving Entity; <U>provided</U> that if there shall be more than one such parent entity, the parent entity closest to ownership of MSG
Knickerbockers&#8217; assets shall be deemed to be the MSG Knickerbockers Surviving Entity. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>MSG Rangers
Surviving Entity</I>&#8221; means the entity that owns, directly or indirectly, after consummation of any transaction, substantially all of the Company&#8217;s assets (as constituted immediately prior to such transaction). If any such entity is at
least majority-owned, directly or indirectly, by any entity (a &#8220;parent entity&#8221;) which has shares of common stock (or partnership units) traded on a national stock exchange or the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">over-the-counter</FONT></FONT> market, as reported on the New York Stock Exchange or any other stock exchange, then such parent entity shall be deemed to be the MSG Rangers Surviving Entity; <U>provided</U> that if there
shall be more than one such parent entity, the parent entity closest to ownership of the Company&#8217;s assets shall be deemed to be the MSG Rangers Surviving Entity. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<I>Offer price per share</I>&#8221; means, in the case of a tender offer or exchange offer which results in a MSG
Rangers Change of Control or a going-private transaction with respect to the Company (an &#8220;<I>Offer</I>&#8221;), the greater of (i)&nbsp;the highest price per share of common stock paid pursuant to the Offer or (ii)&nbsp;the highest fair market
value per share of common stock during the ninety <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(90)-day</FONT> period ending on the date of a MSG Rangers Change of Control or a going-private transaction with respect to the Company. Any securities or property
which are part or all of the consideration paid for shares of common stock in the Offer shall be valued in determining the offer price per share at the higher of (A)&nbsp;the valuation placed on such securities or property by the Company, person or
other entity making such offer or (B)&nbsp;the valuation placed on such securities or property by the Committee. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">A1-7 </P>

</DIV></Center>
